description: Capability for the pre-launch update splash window. The splash calls no commands at all - Rust drives it through WebviewWindow::eval - so it requests nothing. NOTE: this does not sandbox it. The `default` capability is scoped to ["*", "echo"], and that `*` matches `splash`, so the splash inherits the full default permission set anyway. This file exists to declare intent and to keep the splash working if that glob is ever narrowed.
